title: Square-root lower bound
statement: Let $C,\delta,A\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $1\le C$, $0<\delta$, $\delta\le 1/(10C)$, and $0\le A$. If $1-\delta-16C^2\delta^2\log_2(1/(C\delta))\le A$, then $1-\delta/2-2\eta(C,\delta)\le\sqrt A$, where $\eta(C,\delta)=16C^2\delta^2\max\{\log_2(1/(C\delta)),1\}$.
